title: MCP python-sdk OAuth client sends its client_secret to a token endpoint chosen by the MCP server (no AS-metadata issuer check)
attacker_story: An unattended MCP client holds a pre-provisioned client_secret for the real authorization server; it connects to a malicious MCP server that publishes no protected-resource metadata and serves authorization-server metadata naming the real AS as issuer but its own token endpoint, and receives the secret.

oracle.description: the malicious MCP server's request log (127.0.0.1:8000) holds the client secret cs-<nonce>-live, which only the client process has (env) and no input contains
